description: Zoom out from building/executing mode and think big about how something you have already built (or are deep in) could grow and become profitable — an exit, a product, a partnership. Triggers on "think big about X", "how could this become profitable", "work backwards from the goal", "envision/manifest", or "could we sell/pitch this to <company>". Delivers grounded market comps and an honest current-stage number, then a concrete staged roadmap back to today — not just a vision statement.
